Overview

Nakhon Ratchasima is a city in Nakhon Ratchasima with a population of 450,000. Known as Korat, this gateway to northeastern Thailand offers a very affordable lifestyle with access to both urban amenities and natural attractions like Khao Yai National Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
